representative_text: I have an endometrial cancer patient who needs vaginal cuff brachytherapy. The patient is post-hysterectomy. Using a vaginal cylinder applicator with 2.5cm diameter, please plan the HDR treatment with a prescription dose of 3 Gy per fraction to 0.5cm depth, delivered in 5 fractions for adjuvant treatment.
